title: Protobuf
description: Protocol Buffers - a language-neutral, platform-neutral extensible mechanism for serializing structured data.

data.text: Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) is a method developed by Google for serializing structured data. It is language-neutral and platform-neutral, and is commonly used with gRPC for high-performance communication.

data.title: Serialization with Protobuf
data.content: Define a Protobuf message and serialize it.

terms.definition: A schema definition file that describes the structure of Protobuf messages.
A static class generated from a .proto file for deserializing messages.

data.title: Note
data.text: Protobuf requires a schema definition (.proto file) which is compiled into C# classes.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Protobuf is a binary serialization format
data.takeaway: Protobuf is ideal for cross-language, high-performance APIs.
